independenceScope: Actual distinct recorded PNG files, delivered asset hashes and decoded RGB are checked. Native attribution and completeness of provider attempt history rely on producer ledgers; this is not a provider-wide log or a new exhaustive visual fidelity review.

countingDefinitions.nativeOutput: One distinct actual PNG in the final producer ledgers; references, technical composites, frame crops and exports excluded.
countingDefinitions.contributor: One native output supplying at least one final whole atlas pose.
countingDefinitions.whollyUnselected: Native PNG supplying no final selected CG or atlas pose; unused cells in a partly contributing native are not extra native outputs.
countingDefinitions.delivery: An individual accepted CG or one installed sixteen-frame sheet, never the count of generated attempts.
